test_categorical_isna: test the Categorical.isna() method to identify NA values in a categorical array
test_categorical_fillna: test the Categorical.fillna() method to replace NA values with specified category values
test_categorical_na_flags_int_categories: test constructing a Categorical with integer categories and NA flags represented as -1
test_categorical_compare_with_missing: test equality and inequality comparisons between Categorical Series with missing values
test_categorical_only_missing_values: test creating a Categorical containing only missing values without dtype casting
